workspace_missing: The workspace is no longer available in Orca
project_missing: Orca did not report the workspace's project
parent_conflict: Choose one parent or no parent
parent_missing: The parent workspace is no longer available in Orca
base_missing: Choose an available base branch or tag
name_invalid: Enter a worktree name without path separators
preset_missing: The sparse checkout preset is no longer available
source_invalid: Choose an issue or pull request
source_missing: The selected GitHub source is no longer available
pr_unresolved: Orca did not resolve the pull request's source commit
create_unconfirmed: Orca did not report the created worktree; refresh before retrying
url_invalid: Enter a GitHub issue or pull request URL
source_not_found: This GitHub source was not found
url_project: The URL does not belong to the selected project's GitHub source
preset_path: Preset directories must be relative paths inside the repository
preset_empty: Enter a preset name and at least one directory
main_workspace: The project's main workspace cannot be deleted
main_checkout: The repository's main checkout cannot be deleted
children: Move or delete this workspace's children before deleting it
update_delete: Update Orca before deleting workspaces so branches and archive hooks are protected
deleting: Orca is still deleting this worktree; refresh to check its status
source_changed: The selected GitHub source changed; select it again
branch_taken: Branch {branch} is already checked out at {path}
github_unavailable: Some GitHub sources could not be loaded. Check Orca's GitHub connection or try another search.
workspace_ambiguous: The workspace identity is ambiguous; refresh Orca before continuing
composer_required: Advanced creation options require composer mode
update_composer: Update Orca before using the advanced worktree composer
git_source_required: Choose a Git workspace as the source project
composer_conflict: Composer mode cannot use a legacy branch or checkout path
folder_parent_unsupported: This Orca host cannot use a folder workspace as a parent
preview_invalid: Preview must be requested separately from deletion or reconciliation
preview_required: Preview this exact workspace again before deleting it
preview_stale: The workspace or its changes differ from the preview; review a new preview
identity_unavailable: The engine could not verify this workspace identity; refresh before continuing
folder_branch: Folder workspaces do not have a branch to delete
delete_dispatched: Deletion was already sent; reconcile its status before any further action
catalog_incomplete: Orca returned an incomplete workspace catalog; refresh before continuing
mode_invalid: Creation mode flags must be booleans
source_branch_conflict: An existing branch cannot also be a pull request checkout; choose one source
field_invalid: Worktree option fields must use the expected JSON types
no_commits: {path} has no commits yet, so a new worktree cannot be made from it; commit once, or work in the folder itself
close_unsupported: Closing this workspace is not supported by its engine
herdr_children: Close the linked workspaces first, then reopen this workspace’s Close action.
runtime_away: {engine} is not connected to Persona (not running, or just starting); open it and try again
runtime_workspace_missing: {engine} no longer lists this workspace; refresh and try again
runtime_folder: {engine} keeps its worktrees in {path}; only the folder name can be chosen
runtime_parent: {engine} places a new worktree in the project of its source workspace; another parent cannot be chosen
runtime_unconfirmed: {engine} did not report the created worktree; refresh before retrying
runtime_prepare: {engine} did not say where it keeps worktrees; update it and try again
runtime_source_required: Choose the workspace or folder to make the worktree from
runtime_folder_name: {engine} can’t name a worktree folder “{name}”; use letters a–z or digits
runtime_folder_taken: {path} already exists, so {engine} would put the worktree somewhere else; choose another name
runtime_slow: {engine} didn’t finish making the worktree in time; refresh to see whether it appeared before retrying
agent_branch_exhausted: No branch name is free for the Agent’s worktree: its name and the next 49 are all taken
runtime_not_owned: {engine} did not make this worktree, so Persona does not delete it; remove it in {engine}
runtime_folder_kept: This {engine} workspace is a folder, not a worktree; Persona deletes only worktrees {engine} made
runtime_busy: An Agent is still working in this worktree; wait until it is done or stop it, then try again
runtime_folder_gone: The worktree’s folder {path} is gone; refresh to see what {engine} lists now
runtime_git_gone: {path} is no longer a Git worktree: its record in the repository is gone, so Persona does not delete it; remove it in {engine}
runtime_not_toplevel: {path} is a folder inside a worktree, not the worktree itself; Persona deletes only a whole worktree
runtime_folder_left: {engine} archived the workspace but kept its folder {path}; remove the folder in {engine} or by hand
runtime_remove_unanswered: {engine} didn’t answer while removing the worktree; refresh to see whether it is gone before trying again
